description.en: The ID of the cloud computer.
The name of the cloud computer.

description.zh:
分页查询时，每页最大行数。

- 最大值：100
- 默认值：20
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

*   Valid values: 1 to 100.
*   Default value: 20.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of `NextToken`.

description.zh: 办公网络ID。可调用[DescribeOfficeSites](~~216071~~)获取该参数。
description.en: The ID of the office network. You can call the [DescribeOfficeSites](~~216071~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service.

description.zh: 镜像升级任务的信息。可调用[DescribeFotaTasks](~~437001~~)获取该参数。
description.en: The ID of the image update task. You can call the [DescribeFotaTasks](~~437001~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

title.zh: 获取待升级镜像的云电脑信息
